scope: Whole model configuration controls both original roles. Roles, pairs and seeds from one original graph are not independent NPC treatment effects.

measurement.strict_event: Successful native actor/class/target IDs match the source-bound original event; implicit Get uses current source parent. No receipt is relabeled as Steal/Get event.
measurement.material: Get/Steal recursive ownership; Give/Put exact parent; Wear/Wield exact mode; Eat/Drink same actor consumes bound item into VOID. Drop/Remove have no substituted state label.
measurement.initial: Initial true is reported explicitly. Newly reached only has initially-false measurable episodes in its denominator; None is never failure.
measurement.first_turn: -1 is already true at initial state; 0..31 are actual alternating primitive opportunities. Histograms are raw logical counts, not independent-sample estimates.
measurement.weighting: Within pair average fixed seeds, within original graph average pair values, then equal weight per measurable original graph. Unknown observations and denominators are explicit for every metric.
measurement.both: Co-occurring atomic events/material states are not cooperation success, welfare, agreement fulfillment or complete private purposes.
measurement.native_failed_flag: Legacy driver field stochastic_failure directly records native event.failed. stochastic_failures and native_failed_flag_count are identical audit aliases, not a claim that every failure is random. RewardEvent may fail deterministically for insufficient reward_xp; event-type counts retain this distinction.
measurement.actual_bidirectional_Give: At least one actual Give in each peer direction; includes returning the same item. It does not require different assets, accepted terms or a completed exchange.

both_new_physical.scope: Exclusion categories may overlap; initial truth is not unsupported measurement.

cost.scope: Costs include every supplied profile/full launch once; exact outcome reuse adds no samples or inference calls. Runtime model-load and run sub-timers are reported separately. Occupied GPU-slot intervals prefer wrapper start_epoch to end_epoch, when the wrapper observed child process exit, and include imports, loading, pauses, inference and teardown. Only without a recorded wrapper end is original runtime-file mtime used as a weaker endpoint; this fallback may omit teardown. Parallel launches count separate GPU slots. These are launch/exit wall-clock observations, not GPU-active or kernel timings; no unobserved timings are imputed.

numeric_episode_readback.scope: Compact per-logical-episode metrics/milestones; complete speech, states and inputs remain in original raw artifacts.
